title: 10 Best Eryngium Maritimum Preparations

Tinctures provide a concentrated form for more potent effects, while mucillages are valued for their soothing and healing qualities. Oils extracted from the herb are often used in topical applications for skin conditions. These preparations have been traditionally employed in herbal medicine to support respiratory, digestive, and skin health.
